verdicts.reason: A: the two badges are huge and stacked, so they outweigh the headline and compete with the CTA. The body copy is tiny and illegible, and the top badge is jammed against the canvas edge. It does keep the product art intact and gives a sensible left-to-right flow ending on the CTA. B: the can has come apart from its circle, and the body copy sits on top of the circle, jammed against the left edge. The SOLSTICE wordmark has dropped below the headline. The CTA has shrunk to the size of the badges in one cramped row, and a large dead gap is left in the middle.
